full_prompt_en: A square, highly detailed portrait places a young child at the center of a dense garden. The child faces the viewer directly, head and shoulders visible, with a composed expression and wide brown eyes. Dark hair is gathered into rounded sections across the top and sides of the head, making a sculptural silhouette against foliage. A black garment with tiny light dots appears beneath a white scalloped collar; a bright red ribbon is tied at the throat. The face is softly lit from the front, with clear highlights in the eyes and gently modeled skin. All around, glossy leaves crowd close to the head and shoulders. Large layered blossoms in pink, coral, and deep rose fill the lower and right parts of the frame, while smaller pale flowers punctuate the darker greenery. Some petals sit in front of the garment, and others recede behind the child's head, creating a carefully stacked shallow depth. The background has almost no open sky or wall; it is a continuous tapestry of overlapping leaves, stems, and petals. Texture is exceptionally precise: individual petals, leaf veins, and patterned cloth are visible, yet the overall image retains a polished photographic smoothness. Greens range from emerald to olive and near-black, letting the warm flowers and red ribbon stand out. The lighting is even but slightly theatrical, as if each face and leaf has been separately chosen for clarity. The close frontal composition feels formal and quietly uncanny, with the child's still gaze anchored amid lush, almost too-perfect botanical abundance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节极丰富的肖像把一名年幼孩子置于密集花园中央。孩子直面观众，露出头和肩，神情镇定，棕色眼睛睁得很大。深色头发在头顶和两侧收成圆团，于绿叶前形成雕塑般轮廓。白色波浪边领下是一件带细小浅色圆点的黑衣，喉前系着鲜红蝴蝶结。面孔从正面受到柔光照亮，眼中有清晰亮点，肌肤轻柔塑形。四周有光泽的叶片紧贴头肩。粉、珊瑚和深玫瑰色的大型层瓣花朵填满画面下部及右侧，较小的浅色花散落在深绿之间。有些花瓣挡在衣服前，有些退到头后，形成精心叠放的浅景深。背景几乎没有开放天空或墙面，而是由重叠叶、茎、花瓣连续织成的毯面。质感极为精确：单片花瓣、叶脉和衣纹都可辨认，整体仍带精修摄影的平滑感。绿色从翡翠、橄榄延伸到近黑，衬出暖色花朵和红领结。光线均匀却略有舞台感，仿佛每一张面孔、每片叶都被单独选来保持清楚。近距离正面构图正式且隐隐奇异，孩子静止的目光稳在丰盛、近乎过于完美的植物之间。
style_prompt_en: Use a polished photographic collage quality with exceptionally crisp botanical detail and gently smoothed focal surfaces. Pack the frame edge to edge with layered leaves and flowers, creating a shallow yet carefully separated depth through overlapping edges. Build a deep emerald, olive, and near-black green field, then place selective coral, rose, cream, and vivid red accents where attention should gather. Keep the main focal form frontal, still, and softly illuminated, with clear eye-level contact when a figure is present. Make the abundance precise and slightly uncanny, balancing realistic texture with an almost constructed perfection.
style_prompt_zh: 采用精修摄影拼贴般的质感：植物细节异常清晰，焦点表面则轻柔平滑。让层叠叶片与花朵从边到边填满画面，以互相遮挡的边缘形成浅而分明的纵深。铺陈翡翠、橄榄和近黑的深绿色域，再以少量珊瑚、玫瑰、奶油和鲜红聚拢注意。主要焦点形体保持正面、静止、柔和受光；若有人物，则保留齐平视线接触。丰盛细节精确而略带奇异，在真实肌理与仿佛精心构造的完美之间取平衡。
theme_en: A child with red ribbon among dense flowers and dark green leaves
theme_zh: 系红蝴蝶结的孩子立于密集花朵和深绿叶间
name: Ruud van Empel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
